reviews.text: I want to love using this app but there is something fundamentally wrong with it. My location needs to be registered for the bird recordings to be saved for future review. I see my latitude and longitude listed but when I end the recording - it says 'location unknown 0 birds'. Is it because I’ve not donated to Cornell Lab (which I’m constantly being asked to do)? I think if it’s doing this, it’s almost pointless because the pleasure was in reading about the birds and listening to their song again when I’d finished my walk. I’m of the generation that doesn’t go on a walk clutching a phone!!

reviews.title: Update looses data
reviews.text:
The most recent update really screwed things up. When you stop recording, if you don’t immediately wait for the transcript to be done and then hit save which you can’t do until it gets done moving it then you hit save and wait a long time but if you don’t do that right away, you lose your data cause if soon as you go to another app or the lock screen goes on you’ve lost it if you haven’t had it saved so we’re in the past it saved it automatically. I’m not the only one we were on a four hour bird walk the other day and even the leader didn’t realize that the update screwed you over and we lost four hours worth of bird data. You could always delete the recordings so I don’t see any point in changing it to having to purposely save it.
Reduced to one star since I lost another 90 minutes of recording when the device switched to another app after stopping the recording but while it was doing something before the save button became active. And since the developers don’t seem to want to address the glaring defect of removing autosave, it wasn’t there when switched back to app. As numerous others have pointed out this is a serious defect causing lose of much data.
